Subject: Call for Non-Spam Data for CEAS 2008 filtering challenge

Dear Colleague,

This year  were are planning to organize an online spam filtering 
challenge within the framework of CEAS 2008 (http://ceas.cc).  While 
part of the data stream for the competition will be live data, some of 
the evaluation data will also be collected in advance (particularly 
non-spam messages). 

As part of the data collection effort, we have set up a website through 
which it is possible to donate non-sensitive legitimate email, to be 
used in the evaluation.  Any kind of email that the recipient considers 
legitimate is welcome, including computer generated (non-spam) messages. 

The data collection site is hosted at: http://ceas.klika.eu/

Your contribution would help a great deal in making the CEAS 2008 spam 
challenge a success.

With regards,

CEAS 2008 Organizing Committee:

--Aleksander Kolcz
-- Andrej Bratko
-- Barry Leiba
-- Tobias Scheffer
